content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Changes made in response to the verifier:**
1. **Refund element now in operative language** — the new clause reads "...in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro rata basis, all prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination," rather than relying on Section 10.2's narrower "prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination."
2. **Express numbering** — the inserted paragraph now begins "9.4", so the amended Section 2.1 cross-reference ("subject to Section 9.4") resolves on the face of the document.
3. **Level held at preferred** — 30 days' notice retained rather than reworking to the 60–90 day fallback, since preferred needed only the refund fix.
4. **Coverage rebuilt** — all four preferred elements now map to operations; no already_met claim remains.
